authority: #K2-529 sec.1/2: read-only - each new-class DRC item cross-tabled against the placement gate's own model; the missing geometric quantity NAMED per item

rows.item: shorting_items #1 - PERSTA# In5 leg x existing P3V3_AUX buried via In4-B.Cu
rows.gate_model: existing via = capsule of PAD radius on the layers of its layer set (with a fictional capsule on In5)
rows.missing_entity: HOLE WALL of the existing via on every layer its drill passes (r=drill/2=0.125mm); In5 carries the drill and no annulus
rows.consequence: leg copper crosses the drill wall => SHORT

rows.item: clearance #2 - existing J12 PTH pad x new P3V3 blind via F.Cu-In2
rows.gate_model: pad = capsule on F.Cu/B.Cu only; new via = annulus capsule on F.Cu and In2
rows.missing_entity: PTH HOLE of the pad on every layer its drill passes (r=drill/2=0.400mm), In2 included
rows.consequence: new annulus 0.1967mm from the pad hole wall => CLEARANCE

named_gap_list: HOLE WALL of existing VIAS - must be an obstacle on EVERY layer the drill passes (a buried In4-B.Cu via exposes its drill on In5 with NO annulus for the model to see)
PTH HOLE of PADS - must be an obstacle on EVERY layer the drill passes (the model builds a PTH pad only on F.Cu/B.Cu, so In2 was blind)
TRUE-SHAPE - NOT implicated: both failures are MISSING ENTITIES, not a coarse approximation of an existing one
